assessment: In this work causal associations between plasma triglyceride (TG) levels and 19 disease traits were identified which may provide valuable insights into the mechanism of TG biology and drug repurposing of TG-lowering agents. The evidence supporting the claims of the authors is solid, based on biobank-scale data in both discovery analysis and replication analysis. The work will be of interest to cardiovascular clinicians, medical geneticists, and pharmaceutical companies.
